en.title: Crown of Ash and the False Dawn
en.premise: In a world where the city's life-support systems are sustained by a soul sacrificed once a year during the 'Night of the Festival,' twins with extraordinary resonance abilities, Kai and Rina, are chosen. To save her brother, Rina plunges into a perilous rebellion to expose the city's deception. But to sustain the light, blood must be spilled—and to extinguish it, one must lose everything.

zh.title: 灰之冠与虚假的黎明
zh.premise: 为了维持都市生命维持装置的运转，每年一度的“祭典之夜”都必须选出祭品献祭灵魂。拥有极高共鸣能力的双胞胎——凯与莉娜，成为了被选中的牺牲者。为了拯救哥哥，妹妹莉娜毅然投身于揭露都市谎言的残酷反叛之中。然而，若要维持光芒，便需鲜血；若要熄灭光芒，则必须失去一切。
